data.app_name: Just Dance VR – Welcome to Dancity
data.description:
Take dancing to a whole new level within an immersive world thanks to Just Dance VR: Welcome to Dancity.

**IMMERSE YOURSELF IN 360° ICONIC UNIVERSES**

Discover a new Just Dance gameplay, with an added 3D dimension and two-hand scoring thanks to VR. The music surrounds and immerses you in a way never seen before. You can compete and interact with up to 6 players.


**ENJOY A TRACKLIST FOR EVERYONE’S TASTES**

Just Dance VR: Welcome to Dancity features 25 songs and universes, from chart-topping hits and original songs, including:

- **Don’t Stop Me Now** by Queen

- **Bad Liar** by Selena Gomez

- **How You Like That** by BLACKPINK

- **Lights** by Ellie Goulding

- **Call Me Maybe** by Carly Rae Jepsen

- **Starships** by Nicki Minaj

- **A Little Party Never Killed Nobody (All We Got)** by Fergie Ft. Q-Tip, GoonRock

**And many more!**


**DANCE, PLAY, AND INTERACT WITH YOUR FRIENDS AND PLAYERS ONLINE**

Have fun with your friends and dancers around the world thanks to private or public matchmaking.

Discover the social hub, Dancity, where you can roam freely, meet up to 18 players, and shine in your customizable avatar.

Customize your avatar and choose your body shape, facial expression, hair, and outfit.


**CHALLENGE YOURSELF AND GET REWARDED**

Improve your skills and personalize your experience thanks to rewards. These collectibles range from in-game emote stickers, toys (basketball and glow stick), and aliases to full outfits to customize your avatar.

changelog.change_log:
Performance
- Significant performance improvements across various maps for smoother gameplay.
- Enhanced memory usage in core areas to improve stability and responsiveness.
- Optimized UI loading to reduce performance impacts during high-activity moments.

Avatars
- Added new Just Dance inspired coachs make-ups (Regnir, Nefertari, Sara, Kym Noe, Night Sara, Agent D, Fuchsia Blue)
- Improved arm length and height calibration system, now applied to networked players as well.
- Increased resolution on certain avatar outfits to address pixelation issues.
- Adjusted avatar rig for a more polished and cohesive visual presentation.

Multiplayer
- Overhauled network sessions, matchmaking, and travel systems for enhanced stability, allowing players to stay together more consistently when transitioning between sessions.
- Reworked the "Join Group" (The Ultimate Alliance) goal trigger to work with Meta Invites.
- Offline scores, including new high scores, are now cached and will sync to leaderboards upon reconnecting to the network.
- Fixed issues with session creation caused by microphone permissions popup.
- VoIP settings now persist when players join a group.

Localization
- Fixed instances of overlapping and misaligned text in the UI.
- Corrected various grammatical issues.
- Localized some previously missed text elements from launch.

UI/UX
- Resolved display errors in player progression levels; now accurately ranges from level 1-300.
- Enhanced the Song of the Week kiosk text and leaderboard visuals.
- Improved text readability, particularly in Japanese localizations with low-contrast fonts.
- Fixed avatar preview to remain static while customizing when moving in-game.
- FTUE (First Time User Experience) windows now center more effectively and prioritize visibility. 
- Addressed various issues with player profile stats and high scores not displaying or saving correctly.
- Added text labels to player nameplate buttons for clearer functionality.
- Fixed instances of Dance Cards displaying incorrectly or missing.
- Trophy names now display properly when visiting other players’ Apartments.
- Updated Quickplay notification text to “Finding your next song with Quickplay.”

Visuals
- Addressed minor visual bugs in both Dancity and the Apartment areas.
- Gold Move VFX and SFX added to maps previously missing these cues.
- Improved graphics across multiple maps with enhanced visuals and bug fixes.
- Corrected VFX, dancer, and core UI layering to ensure proper draw order.
- Fixed graphical issues with portals, including appearance in floor reflections on specific maps.
- Resolved flickering issues in the “Jai Ho! (You Are My Destiny)” map when the Quest menu is open.
